test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rita, Saroj, Pawan, Vijay and Anoop are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. Pawan is sitting immediately left of Saroj and second to the right of Anoop. Rita is sitting immediately left of Pawan.

Who is sitting immediately right of Vijay?
solution: **Given: **Rita, Saroj, Pawan, Vijay and Anoop are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. 1) Pawan is sitting immediately left of Saroj and second to the right of Anoop.
